title: Nourishing Fluffy Vietnamese Fish Canh Chua
description: A savory and fluffy Vietnamese dish featuring elderflower and bonito shave, wrapped in a lotus leaf. This nut-free-friendly recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Rinse the lotus leaves and cut off the stems.
In a large pot, combine the fish balls, elderflower syrup, bonito flakes, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, and salt.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
While the mixture is cooking, prepare the lotus leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
To assemble the dish, place a few fish balls in the center of each lotus leaf, then spoon some of the cooking liquid over the top.
Fold the lotus leaves over the filling to form a tight packet.
Serve the Canh Chua hot, garnished with additional elderflower syrup and bonito flakes if desired.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving.
